search_results.title: Critical Flaw Patched In Widely Used Logging Library
search_results.snippet: Maintainers of a widely used logging library shipped an emergency patch for a flaw that allowed remote code execution on vulnerable servers.

search_results.title: Ransomware Group Shifts To Double Extortion Tactics
search_results.snippet: Security researchers observed a ransomware group increasingly stealing data before encrypting it, then threatening separate leaks.

search_results.title: Agency Mandates Multi-Factor Auth For Contractors
search_results.snippet: A government agency now requires multi-factor authentication for all contractor access to its internal systems starting next quarter.

search_results.title: Browser Extension Store Removes Data-Stealing Add-Ons
search_results.snippet: A browser's extension store removed a batch of add-ons found to be exfiltrating browsing history and saved form data.
